sections.title: Feedforward Neural Networks — Layers, Notation and Parameters

blocks.html: Start here A feedforward neural network is just many sigmoid-type neurons arranged in layers, where information flows one way : from the input, through hidden layers, to the output. This page fixes the notation (ai,hi,Wi,bi)(a_{i}, h_{i}, W_{i}, b_{i})(ai​,hi​,Wi​,bi​) that the whole of backpropagation uses — learn it well and the rest becomes much easier.

  4. Backpropagation passes blame from the loss down through the layers using the chain rule.
  5. With softmax + cross-entropy, the output gradient is just ŷ − e(ℓ).
